topic: Foundations of Linear Algebra: From Combinations to Bases

sections.title: Prerequisite Review: Vectors as Arrows
lecture_lines: Vectors are directed segments in 2D space.
Scaling and adding vectors build everything.
animations: Display vector v (#FF5733) and vector w (#33FF57) as arrows from origin.
Move vector v to end at coordinate (2,1) and label it 'v'.
Move vector w to end at coordinate (-1,2) and label it 'w'.
Animate the sum v+w as a new arrow (#3357FF) using the parallelogram rule.
Flash both vectors v and w using a white color (#FFFFFF) for emphasis.

sections.title: Linear Combinations and Span
lecture_lines: Span is the set of all reachable points.
Vectors A and B fill the 2D plane.
animations: Display vectors v (#FF5733) and w (#33FF57) in 2D space.
Show scalar multiplication of v by 2 and w by -1.
Draw grid points illustrating all linear combinations c1v + c2w.
Fill the plane spanned by v and w with light blue (#00FFFF) at 30% opacity.
Move a new vector u across the spanned area to show reachability.

sections.title: Linear Dependence: The Redundant Vector
lecture_lines: Linear dependence: redundant vector adds no dimension.
Vector C lying on line A, B is redundant.
Redundant vectors provide no new navigation.
animations: Display two independent vectors v (#FF5733) and w (#33FF57).
Add a third vector u (#3357FF) that lies on the plane defined by v and w.
Flash u in red (#FF0000) to indicate it is linearly dependent.

sections.title: The Concept of Basis
lecture_lines: Basis is the minimal spanning set.
Linearly independent vectors efficiently define space.
Basis is the most efficient coordinate system.
animations: Display standard basis vectors i-hat (#FF5733) and j-hat (#33FF57).
Show scaling i-hat by 3 and j-hat by 2 to reach point (3,2).
Display grid lines defined by the basis vectors i-hat and j-hat.

sections.title: Summary and Synthesis
animations: Create a text list of concepts: 'Span', 'Dependence', and 'Basis'.
Draw lines connecting these three concepts to show their interrelation.
Highlight the connection between 'Dependence' and 'Basis' with a bold line.
